description: The SynD research team publishes an early version of its synthetic power-consumption dataset generator as a distinct software deposit. It belongs to the documented SynD simulation process, which uses recorded household-appliance power traces to construct aggregate and appliance-level electricity observations. Figshare provides the generator as a ZIP archive under CC0, and a neighbouring deposit supplies the template power patterns. Access is free. The published SynD benchmark represents 21 appliances over 180 simulated days at a temporal resolution of 5 Hz, but the public generator landing page does not establish which settings are configurable or promise the same output for a new run. It can support household-demand scenarios and synthetic evaluation inputs for building energy simulations, complementing measured data such as data-uk-dale-domestic-appliance-level-electricity. A caveat is that the own page labels this an early version and does not expose an installation guide, software language or dependency list. Those details require inspection of the package before use. The archive was not downloaded and the generator was not run.
